name: Cod
note: Cod broadly flat. Markets unmoved, as is traditional.

name: Haddock
note: Haddock down 3% amid unspecified concerns.

name: Mackerel
note: Mackerel up slightly. Analysts declined to elaborate.

name: Plaice
note: Plaice unchanged. Plaice has never been anything other than unchanged.

name: Sole
note: Sole up 2.1% after being named sole bidder in a deal it has not yet been told about.

name: Halibut
note: Halibut falls 5.2%. The board describes this as a controlled descent.

name: Salmon
note: Salmon continues upstream against prevailing market sentiment, as expected.

name: Trout
note: Trout down 1.1%. A spokesperson called the figure 'within the range of things that happen.'

name: Herring
note: Herring down 6.8% after last week's rally was confirmed to be a red herring. Fish News regrets nothing.

name: Kipper
note: Kipper trading suspended pending an inquiry into what happened to Herring.

name: Sardine
note: Sardine up 0.9%. Trading floor described by attendees as extremely crowded.

name: Anchovy
note: Anchovy gains 3.4% on small but notably salty volume.

name: Pollock
note: Pollock steady. Analysts called the outlook 'broadly abstract.'

name: Turbot
note: Turbot up 12.3% following a restructuring the company will refer to only as 'the upgrade.'

name: Monkfish
note: Monkfish flat. Shareholders remain bound by a vow of silence.

name: Anglerfish
note: Anglerfish up 4% on a merger with Monkfish that both parties insist is not a merger, as they are the same fish.

name: Sea Bass
note: Sea Bass down 0.7%. Low trading volume blamed on nobody being able to hear it.

name: Bream
note: Bream up 1.2%. The chairman attributes growth to 'daring to bream.' He has been asked to stop.

name: Pike
note: Pike up 2.8% after acquiring three smaller ponds in what Pike alone describes as a friendly takeover.

name: Carp
note: Carp up 0.3%. A long-term holder says Carp has occupied the same pond since 1974 and intends to outlast the market.

name: Eel
note: Eel slips 2.2%. Repeated attempts to pin down a spokesperson were unsuccessful.

name: Tuna
note: Tuna down 2.5%. Tuna maintains the market has been tinned against it from the start.

name: Swordfish
note: Swordfish up 7.5% following a defence contract Fish News was politely asked not to mention.

name: Shark
note: Shark up 3.9%. Its lending terms remain, in its own words, 'extremely competitive.'

name: Pufferfish
note: Pufferfish surges 18.2%. Analysts caution the valuation may be somewhat inflated.

name: Blobfish
note: Blobfish down 9.1% under pressure. Representatives insist it looks perfectly fine at depth.

name: Goldfish
note: Goldfish up 0.1%. The board has no recollection of last quarter, or of this morning.

name: Catfish
note: Catfish down 4.4% after its chief executive was found to be a different fish entirely.

name: Minnow
note: Minnow up 22% from a very modest base. Minnow has asked to be taken seriously.

name: Fish Finger
note: Fish Finger down 1.9%. Regulators are still unable to establish which fish it is.

name: Coelacanth
note: Coelacanth unmoved. Chunce Whatney, who claims to have held shares since the Devonian, called today's session 'nothing compared to the Permian.'

name: Skate
note: Skate slips 2.6%. The board maintains this was a planned manoeuvre.

name: Hake
note: Hake up 1.4%. Nobody could say why, and nobody asked.

name: Whiting
note: Whiting flat pending a decision it describes as imminent. It has been whiting since March.

name: Ling
note: Ling up 0.5%. The ling-term outlook is described as stable.

name: Dab
note: Dab up 1.0% after a brief, confident gesture by the chairman that shareholders have asked him to stop doing.

name: Flounder
note: Flounder down 4.9%. Its chief executive, when asked for a strategy, took some time.

name: John Dory
note: John Dory up 2.3%. Fish News confirms John Dory is a fish and not a named individual. Our lawyers are satisfied.

name: Gurnard
note: Gurnard down 0.8%. Its objections to the figure were loud, sustained, and ignored.

name: Lemon Sole
note: Lemon Sole down 3.7% after being confirmed as neither a lemon nor a sole. Trading Standards are involved.

name: Mullet
note: Mullet flat. Serious at the front, speculative at the back.

name: Perch
note: Perch up 0.6%. It has held the same position for eleven quarters and shows no intention of moving.

name: Roach
note: Roach up 5.1%. Analysts expect it to survive any downturn, and very possibly the market itself.

name: Tench
note: Tench down 1.3%. Tench declined to comment from the bottom, as is customary.

name: Barracuda
note: Barracuda up 6.2% after a quarter it describes as 'assertive' and competitors describe as 'a bite.'

name: Marlin
note: Marlin down 3.4% following a prolonged struggle with an elderly private investor lasting several days.

name: Stingray
note: Stingray down 2.0%. Investors are advised to shuffle in rather than step in.

name: Piranha
note: Piranha up 9.8% after consuming its sector in under four minutes. The competition inquiry has been reduced to a skeleton.

name: Lamprey
note: Lamprey up 1.5%. It has declined to disclose its host.

name: Remora
note: Remora up 3.9%, precisely in line with Shark. Remora denies any connection.

name: Sturgeon
note: Sturgeon up 4.4%. Its premium roe division remains out of reach for anyone who would need to ask the price.

name: Squid
note: Squid trading halted after auditors confirmed it is not a fish. Squid's response was, by all accounts, inky.

name: Cuttlefish
note: Cuttlefish suspended alongside Squid, having attempted to blend in with the rest of the listings.

name: Jellyfish
note: Jellyfish down 2.9%. Management, accused of lacking a backbone, confirmed this was accurate.

name: Starfish
note: Starfish up 1.1% despite losing an arm in restructuring. It expects to grow a replacement by Q3.

name: Seahorse
note: Seahorse up 0.4%. The father is handling the new offering.

name: Flying Fish
note: Flying Fish gains 8.1%. Analysts expect it to come back down. It always does.

name: Sunfish
note: Sunfish up 0.3%. The largest holding on the exchange continues to drift without apparent purpose.

name: Sprat
note: Sprat down 2.0% after being used to catch a mackerel. Mackerel has not commented.

name: Pilchard
note: Pilchard up 0.5%. It notes it is simply a Sardine with more experience and would like that reflected in the price.

name: Whitebait
note: Whitebait continues to be traded in bulk. Individual holders report feeling somewhat overlooked.

name: Grouper
note: Grouper up 2.7%. Grouper is a consortium, and nobody is entirely sure who is in charge.

name: Snapper
note: Snapper down 1.6%. Its spokesperson answered all questions briefly and without warmth.

name: Wrasse
note: Wrasse up 1.9% after a routine cleaning of several larger stocks' books. No questions were asked.

name: Parrotfish
note: Parrotfish up 0.7% after repeating last quarter's guidance word for word.

name: Clownfish
note: Clownfish up 1.3%. Management reminds investors that it is not a joke.

name: Lionfish
note: Lionfish up 5.9%, having expanded into markets that did not invite it and cannot now remove it.

name: Lungfish
note: Lungfish flat. It has spent the quarter in a burrow and expects to emerge when conditions improve.

name: Oarfish
note: Oarfish up 11.4% on its first appearance in months. Experienced traders regard any sighting as a bad omen.

name: Megalodon
note: Megalodon delisted some time ago. Chunce Whatney maintains he shorted it personally and was present for the final session.
